news.title: Not a theft, but a statement: Inside the Bitcoin proposal to reassign Satoshi-linked coins
news.summary: Paul Sztorc says he can't move a single sat of Satoshi's bitcoin and isn't trying to. But critics say rewriting forked-chain balances at addresses a user does not control sets a bad precedent.

news.title: 'Crypto Godfather' says bitcoin has not reached its bottom and a new all-time high is off the table for 2026
news.summary: The early bitcoin investor and author of Bitcoin Supercycle says bitcoin needs to drop to about $57,000 sometime in October before beginning its ascent. A market analyst disagrees.

news.title: Every blockchain transaction is a gift to your competition
news.summary: As AI Agents reshape commerce, and make every business an open book, companies will need to figure out what data actually needs to be kept secret – and protect it ferociously – in order to thrive.

news.title: A crypto coalition releases technical proposal to save Aave users from a massive token exploit
news.summary: DeFi United, a coalition of multiple blockchain projects and crypto ecosystem individuals, has laid out a detailed plan to restore the backing of rsETH after this month’s Kelp DAO hack sent shockwaves

news.title: Riot extends $200 million Coinbase credit facility, and bitcoin weakness could mean more sales
news.summary: The miner locked in fixed borrowing costs and extended maturity, but a shrinking BTC treasury and loan-to-value triggers leave little room for error if prices slide.
